mapper.select: select from lab_hazard h where h.id=#{hazardId} and h.del_flag='0'
select from lab_hazard h where h.id=#{hazardId} and h.del_flag='0' for update
select from lab_hazard h where h.source_item_id=#{sourceItemId} and h.del_flag='0' limit 1

select distinct from lab_hazard h left join lab_device d on h.target_type='DEVICE' and d.id=h.target_id and d.del_flag='0' where h.del_flag='0'
and ((h.target_type='LABORATORY' and h.target_id in #{id}) or (h.target_type='DEVICE' and d.laboratory_id in #{id})) and 1=0 and h.owner_id=#{ownerId}and h.status=#{status}and h.severity=#{severity} order by h.create_time desc
select id from lab_device where laboratory_id=#{laboratoryId} and del_flag='0' order by id

select h.id from lab_hazard h join lab_device d on d.id=#{deviceId} and d.del_flag='0' where h.del_flag='0' and h.severity='MAJOR' and h.status in ('PENDING_RECTIFICATION','RECTIFYING','PENDING_REVIEW') and ((h.target_type='DEVICE' and h.target_id=d.id) or (h.target_type='LABORATORY' and h.target_id=d.laboratory_id)) order by h.id for update
mapper.update: update lab_hazard set status=#{target},update_by=#{updateBy},update_time=#{updateTime},version=version+1 where id=#{hazardId} and status=#{expected} and del_flag='0'

update lab_hazard set overdue_flag='1',overdue_set_at=#{now},overdue_event_version=overdue_event_version+1,update_by=#{updateBy},update_time=#{now},version=version+1 where id in (select id from (select id from lab_hazard where deadline < #{now} and status <> 'CLOSED' and overdue_flag='0' and del_flag='0' order by id limit #{batchSize}) due)
mapper.select: select count(1) from lab_usage_record where device_id=#{deviceId} and returned_at is null and del_flag='0'
select count(1) from lab_repair_order where device_id=#{deviceId} and status in ('WAIT_ASSIGN','WAIT_REPAIR','IN_PROGRESS','WAIT_ACCEPTANCE') and del_flag='0'
